layout_rules: All portrait text is manually line-broken within 900px safe width.
All portrait content uses 64px minimum side margin.
Promo title and body line baselines are fixed and do not approach the right or bottom edge.
All sample card text is line-broken and kept inside a 1200x900 canvas with 28px outer inset.
The icon is redrawn with a solid rounded-square background and no transparent or black corner artifacts.
App icon and dark wordmark have opaque full canvas backgrounds, avoiding transparent corner artifacts.
note: Promotional panels are marketing artwork, not screenshots of a live Reddit app.
